objective: Implement and validate a byte-preserving, no-synthesis, wire-level timing normalizer (DCRN) that normalizes visible request->ACK and request->response timing for BOTH native structures (separate: request->pure ACK->response; combined: request->ACK-bearing response), preserving packet structure (ACK-mode normalization stays a Phase 05 primitive).

execution_constraints.ebpf_load: requires real CAP_BPF -- kernel.unprivileged_bpf_disabled=2 on this host; every BPF-load run is a PI sudo invocation (I cannot load/run eBPF). Writing + compiling eBPF is non-privileged.
execution_constraints.capture: non-sudo via `sg wireshark` (philip in wireshark group)
execution_constraints.tc_netem: non-sudo via `unshare -rn` BUT that does NOT grant CAP_BPF for eBPF load
execution_constraints.consequence: DCRN eBPF code, loaders, harness, tests, and analysis are buildable by me; the loopback + two-host wire campaign (5+ runs x 100+ sessions x 2 environments) must be PI-executed under sudo. Final PASS awaits those PI-run results; nothing will be reported as measured until the PCAPs/tables exist.

calibration.rto_source: rto_probe.py (TCP_RTO_MIN); MUST be re-measured on the Vision master before rig runs
calibration.note: Targets DERIVED from the pooled native readiness, not hard-coded. Covering pooled p99.9 leaves 0.07% deadline misses (the SEL-751 slow tail up to ~98 ms), retained and passed native as reported deadline misses. scheduler_guard_ms=3.0 is PROVISIONAL -- re-derive from a real fq/EDT calibration run.

architecture_plan.control_point: tc ingress eBPF (arm request state, pick class-independent deadline) + tc egress eBPF (classify pure ACK vs ACK-bearing response, assign skb EDT) + fq qdisc (release at EDT). On loopback both directions share one egress path (single-egress simplification, per the existing ack_edt.c).
architecture_plan.reuse: reports/phases/phase_04/ebpf_prototype/ack_edt.c (single-egress, separate-mode, fixed 20/40ms) is the starting point; DCRN generalizes it to dual-case + calibrated class-independent target + per-flow deadline arming from the request + the full bypass/fail-open set.
architecture_plan.why_better_than_phase02: the egress scheduler holds packets AFTER the kernel already selected separate/combined, so timing normalization cannot accidentally change the ACK mode (Phase 02's application-write delay can).
